notes.title: The Emulator - Our Second Steam Release
notes.notes:
Our second game, The Emulator, is now available on Steam! The Emulator plays similar to Concluse with a first person perspective but with a much more imminent threat. Explore a house and its secrets as you try to survive the night. There are 4 very different alternate endings, each with their own unique cutscenes. Get the game for free here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/989490/The_Emulator/

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Patch Notes 5 - Higher Res Notes, 60+ FPS, Fixed Inverted Option
notes.notes:
While hard at work with CONCLUSE 2, we wanted to address some of the last remaining issues players have reported in the past with CONCLUSE. The biggest of those being the hard to read notes. We have redone all of the ones we felt had been the most reported and caused the most difficulty in game. Below you can see a before and after of the 'infamous' sewer puzzle note:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/2a32d10f4ecab2de4d67dc8348a583f19a4b4a9b.png

The other two changes in this patch are the addition of a 60 fps option (many of you already know that  by default the game is capped to 20), and a fix for the inverted controls option. We of course understand that not everyone wants to play the game with framerates experienced on the 20+ year old PS1, especially steamers who are also running recording software. The inverted controls fix removed the inverted x-axis, so that now only the y-axis is inverted.

The notes portion of this patch was also part of our mobile 1.3.9 update along with some scene specific tweaks.

Thank you for reading, we hope you're as excited as we are going forward with CONCLUSE 2!

notes.title: Patch Notes 4 - Windowed Mode; Invert Mouse/Look X,Y; Resolution Options
notes.notes:
Introducing the 'Options Patch', while these options likely should have been included with release, they're here now. We know that some of our players have a hard time seeing what's going on with the very low default resolution, and that other players resolutions are stretching to a 16:9 ratio regardless. Now there are 5 resolution options to choose, ranging from the default 472x319 up to 1920x1080. Along with this, there is a simple toggle to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode. The other option we decided to include in this patch is the ability to invert the mouse/right joystick. We hadn't previously thought of this option, but after it being brought up in the discussions we decided to include it. After all, we want as many people to be able to play and enjoy the game as possible.

Changelog

Added OPTIONS menu to titlescreen.
Invert look x,y axis option.
Fullscreen/windowed option.
Five resolution options.
Ctrl-R hotkey added for resetting the resolution (in case of a resolution going off-screen and being unable to navigate to fix it).
Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes 3
notes.notes:

[spoiler]Burned hand caption in sewer goes away now after the sewer draining cutscene plays.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Made hidden sewer lid easier to interact with.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Removed red light behind large valve in sewer, some players understandably thought it was one of the buttons needed for the door.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Made it easier to exit the valve room in the sewers.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Can no longer interact with rat hallway phone through wall.[/spoiler]

Some of the fixes above could be considered spoilers and will only show if hovered over, we suggest only scanning these if you have already played the game or have encountered bugs you would like to check on.

Thank you to all the community members who reported these problems/bugs!

notes.title: Final Trailer Released - Count Down to Game Release
notes.notes:
Final Trailer
At long last the game's final trailer is here. After much hard work on the part of Studio Snowspot, we are proud to present the final trailer. Also, we have announced the winners of our early access soundtrack give away in the video description.
https://youtu.be/s0eQiMUZBIE
13 Days to Go
We're getting close! T Allen Studios is finishing coding and implementing some final 'polish features' like changing footstep sound effects when walking on different surfaces, and both Studio Snowspot and T Allen Studios are conducting tests and fixing any bugs that appear. We hope to have the game completely tested mid-week so we can start the Steamworks build process early, ensuring we get CONCLUSE in your hands as planned the 29th.

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot

notes.title: Release Date Teaser
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/zhQrfUH1IcM
Release Date
As you can now see on the Steam page and in the video above, we now have a public release date. On June 29th, Concluse will be available to download free, as will the official soundtrack. Though the soundtrack will be available on other platforms June 21st for $5.99 as a way of supporting the artists who contributed to it, read the previous article for more information Here.
Final Trailer
Due to the desire to make the final trailer really do the game and its fans justice, we will be leaving you with the release date trailer for now. Over the next couple of weeks Studio Snowspot will be preparing the final trailer, as T Allen Studios works on finishing hooking things up in the games later areas along with some final features.

As always thank you for checking in, and we hope you guys are as excited as we are! The game is almost in your hands!

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot
